name: one-infinite-loop
description: Makes ⌘ (i/c/w, in correspondence with) a working operator in the prompt: a live menu to pick fragments, addresses attached on send, loops drawn as links.

sourceOrder.title: Source order
sourceOrder.description: Order of picker rows and of searches, comma-separated.

enabledSources.title: Enabled sources
enabledSources.description: Sources that are switched on, comma-separated.

notionServer.title: Notion MCP server
notionServer.description: Server name as /mcp lists it. Empty: found by its notion-search tool.

scubaServer.title: Scuba MCP server
scubaServer.description: Server name as /mcp lists it. Empty: found by its create_url_capture tool.

obsidianVault.title: Obsidian vault folder
obsidianVault.description: Absolute path of the vault folder. Empty: the obsidian source stays quiet.

obsidianLinkBase.title: Obsidian link base
obsidianLinkBase.description: Prefix that turns a note's path into a link, such as http://localhost:27124/vault/ with the bundled redirect running.

sendBudgetMs.title: Send budget (ms)
sendBudgetMs.description: Longest wait for searches when a prompt is sent.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Most candidates listed for an ambiguous side when a prompt is sent.

linkStyle.title: Link style
linkStyle.description: inline: outside the terminal, the message is redrawn with ⌘ coloured and its sides as links. below: the message stays as Claude Code draws it, with links on a line under it. The terminal always uses below.

shimmerSeconds.title: Shimmer (seconds)
shimmerSeconds.description: How long ⌘ glides through the rainbow in a new message before resting. 0 switches it off.

loopShortcut.title: Loop shortcut
loopShortcut.description: Characters that turn into ⌘ as you type them, such as ;; (2 to 8, no spaces, not only letters or digits). Empty: off. Typing icw and picking ⌘ always works.

loopSound.title: Loop sound
loopSound.description: sosumi: when every loop in a message you send resolves, the Mac plays its own Sosumi alert (macOS only; the sound is not shipped with the mod). off: no sound.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Writes a dim line per hook to the transcript.
